purpose: Relocate neutral wallet extension-ID references out of lifecycle; partition the full application-target catalog by referenced product function.
effective_definition_check: Every rule and defaults object equals the original after translating references; no matcher, severity, scope, exclusion, threshold, proximity, or mapping changed.
external_mappings: No active version-drift mapping contained a moved ID. Dated audit inventories retain historical IDs.
placement_review: First pass inventoried every rule before mutation, including broad multi-product and store-or-name unions. All require a single product function; finance unions can span wallets and payment/exchange providers.

Second pass checked each required alternative against its function. BaiduBar observations were separated from the mixed media-control file and assigned to browser. Registered wallet IDs describe referenced applications, not host lifecycle or containing-file identity. PuTTY was likewise separated from CPU-Z and classified as a remote-session network client; wmiexec remains an administration CLI utility.
validator_admission: directory_whitelist.rs admits os/application; its deeper function leaves are accepted by the installed engine. Scans loaded all changed rules without validation warnings.
